title: Carlos was so lovely and...
text:
Carlos was so lovely and a great captain made sure everyone had a good time in a safe manner. 

We were given pillows so we could lay on the front of the boat and enjoy the sun.
author: Luke_F

title: Amazing Ride
text: Beautiful Ride!!!!! Amazing sailboat and skipper was attentive and informative!
author: 586suzetter

title: Incredible
text: It is an incredible experience, I recommend it; our instructor was very nice and very attentive, thanks again for this incredible experience
author: Cali_L

title: Fab day fab hosts
text: Wow what a great experience! The captain and Monica were fabulous hosts and especially with our 2 children. Thoroughly enjoyed every minute!
author: Kirsty_P

title: Great experience!
text: Had an amazing sailboat trip! The sailor Alvaro was friendly, making the journey enjoyable. The snacks and wine were delicious, perfectly complementing the relaxing vibe. The boat was comfy and well-maintained, offering a serene escape on the water. Highly recommend!
author: Qiqi_L

title: High seas day with friends
text: A fantastic experience to enjoy the sea and disconnect from the rhythm of the city. The sailboat is comfortable and the atmosphere, very quiet being a small group. Paddle surfing and snorkelling on the high seas has been the best, and the views of Barcelona from the water are spectacular
author: M2742QZcarlap

title: Great Sailing
text: From the very begging everything was amazing, the service, staff, tour was great, definitely a must to do in Barcelona. 100% Recommended!
author: Tourist50472986116

title: The best of Barcelona
text:
Best Experience Ever! thanks Alvaro and Jon, you made my day! Excellent service and crew, good food and drinks! there was paddle surf, flamingo and more! 
100% Recommended
author: petermJ7489PK

title: Very pleasant boat ride along the coast of Barcelona
text: A very pleasant walk, we did not lack anything. The staff very friendly and very attentive at all times. Highly recommended! We'll repeat one day.
author: carlosbal6

title: Very pleasant!!
text: The boat trip was super enjoyable, Captain Edu was really friendly and treated us amazingly well! The drinks and snacks were plentiful, and the boat was beautiful! I’ll definitely come back if I return to Barcelona!
author: allbbs
